entry.title: [mohsenhesammazaheri] These days, insulting Shariati and other religious intellectuals is, of course,…
entry.summary:
Source: @mohsenhesammazaheri

These days, insulting Shariati and other religious intellectuals is, of course, in vogue, and anyone who comes along hurls insults at them. But one must be fair: regarding the Holy Prophet, at least in Persian and in the contemporary era, no work has yet been written that matches "Muhammad, the Seal of the Prophets," and especially Shariati's essay in it titled "The Face of Muhammad." My knowledge of and devotion to the Prophet I owe to this book and to Shariati's "Islamology"; just as my interest in Quranic studies I owe to Engineer Bazargan and his "The Evolution of the Quran." @mohsenhesammazaheri

#Arma_Publications_New_Releases#New_Religious_StudiesThe 47th title in the Sarv book series (Social Studies of Shiism) has been published:📗Outcast Sufis 📗A Genealogical Study of the Anti-Sufism Movement from the Safavid Era to the First Pahlavi Period ✍️ Saeed MehriFrom the Sarv book series (Social Studies of Shiism) - 49Series Editor: Mohsen Hesam Mazaheri 264 pages - Pocket sizeFirst printing: Mordad 1405Arma PublicationsThis research aims to show that the movement of criticizing Sufism/anti-Sufism (specifically during the Safavid and Qajar periods) was not caused by an epistemological conflict between the opponents of Sufism and the Sufis themselves, but rather several factors were influential in this regard, such as the Safavids' change of religion from Sunnism to Shiism, and moreover, mostly with a jurisprudential and Akhbari reading of the Shiite faith.Online sales: IranKetab, CBook websites, etc.Distribution: Qoqnoos#Sarv_Books #Arma_Publications @sarvbooks@nashre_arma
